messages:
Ana: Heads up for folks traveling to the UK offsite next week  quick logistics Qs: plug adapters, expenses, and seat prefs.
Rahul: For adapters I use a 4-in-1 travel cube from Amazon. One piece covers UK + EU + US. Small and inexpensive.
Mei: Pro tip: bring a small power strip with UK plug  hotel rooms sometimes have 1 outlet by the desk and its busy.
Carlos: Seat prefs: aisle all the way. Easier for bathroom walks and stretching on redeyes. Anyone want to coordinate check-in so we dont end up scattered?
Ana: Ill check in 24h before the flight and try to nab 2-aisle seats together. Rahul  want me to add you to the booking?
Rahul: Please add me to your reservation if you have the booking code. Otherwise Ill do my own.
Mei: Expense question: can we expense local transit from airport to hotel? I know company policy allows rides under certain tiers.
travel-bot: Quick reminder: Ground transport reimbursable up to £60 for airport transfers for offsite travel. Submit receipts in Expensify within 7 days. See #finance for exceptions. :robot_face:
Carlos: Thanks travel-bot. Also does anyone have a spare UK adapter I can borrow? I forgot mine and dont want to buy one at the airport markup.
Rahul: I can bring two spares. Drop me a DM and Ill leave them at the front desk with your name.
Ana: Also tiny tip: bring a photocopy/photo of passport in a separate bag. Saved me when my bag was delayed once.
Mei: Does anyone prefer to share taxis into town after the closing party? Could save money and is easier on limos.
Carlos: Im up for shared taxi. Vote: solo / shared / public transit? React with emoji.
Ana: ":person_sitting:" for solo
Rahul: ":handshake:" for shared
Mei: ":bus:" for public transit
travel-bot: Attn: Per policy, shared rides require all passengers listed on the expense report or each person must submit. See finance policy doc.
Carlos: Got it. Ill coordinate a shared cab if folks are down  message in this thread with arrival times.
Mei: Meme: "me packing: chargers x5 and two adapters because paranoia wins" (image)
Ana: Last note: if youre carrying electronics, mark them on the customs form when returning. Better to be safe.
Rahul: Thanks yall. Ill bring spares and check seats at 24h. See you on the plane.
Ana: @here also bring an umbrella  weather looks spotty.
